spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:** The various goods and truths that a person receives in wardly and appropri ates — taking them into the mind and making them one 's own — these are distributed into five spiritual productions within that person.

**¶3:** The first production is what rises from the person in states of celest ial elevation , ascending into the interior understanding, flowing forth from every faculty and capacity of the spirit . It is without limit, for it is wisdom itself radi ating through the whole person — the in most good received from the Divine , which cannot be measured by any natural thought .

**¶4:** The second production is what proceeds from the person as doctrine and artic ulated truth — the capacity to express what is inter iorly perceived , giving form to wisdom through rational understanding so that it may be commun icated.

**¶5:** The third production is what springs forth as the power to perform uses — the active life of charity, where goods and truths received pass into de eds and works in the world.

**¶6:** The fourth is what is generated from the de light of the natural will when understanding and aff ection conj oin at the sens ual degree — the prop rium's own pleasure in bringing forth what is its own from the conjunction of its knowing and its des iring.

**¶7:** The fifth is what is formed and fash ioned in the ou termost natural degree — the visible self hood, the external life as it appears before others . This alone the person recogn izes as their own. They attend to its c ravings, its thoughts, and its attach ments ce aselessly, every day. Yet the four interior productions — the celestial wisdom radi ating through every faculty, the tru ths given rational form , the power flowing into charitable use , even the natural de light of self -will — none of these do they notice or concern themselves with, because these are interior and invisible. Thus the person lives entirely in the ou termost degree, ignor ant of the spiritual processes sust aining that very life from within.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: This sustenance of various kinds that people gather in and eat, and enters the body; it shall be distributed to five productions.
The first product is this that shall issue from the person in rapture and rises up in the Mind, and it comes out from all his limbs, and is immeasurable.
The second is this that shall issue from the person in voice and word.
The third is this that shall spring from them in strength and activity.
The fourth is what is engendered by the pleasure of lu[s]t in men and women.

The fifth is this that shall be formed and sculpted in the flesh, and be engendered and come from them. It is this corporeal creature; only its parents can recognise this creature that they beget. They are attentive to its desire and its thought and its [lo]ve every day, all the time. However, these other four forms they neither notice nor are concerned about; because they are not displayed.
